limits: Actual billed units do not split by tonnage. The billing carries no vehicle, so the band columns carry the band's expected demand and the market's actual beside it. actual_is_market_level=True marks every such row; do not sum actuals down a band.
The fleet vintage is 2025E for every year, so expected demand is flat over time by construction. Only the billing and the capture move.

F-series exists as a fleet in three markets only (ITUK, Portugal, Ireland) and is 1,238 vehicles in total. It carries an expected demand but almost no attributable billing, because the billing has no vehicle.
UTI has no 3.5 t band at all: 2,360 CV warranty VINs show no NLR/NMR/NKR.
The ITUK lane is the IML v7 schedule and is not comparable with the PRISM lane. Never average or sum the two.
AIM level 1 resolves on 99.3% of billed euro; level 2 on a little less. The remainder is reported as Unclassified rather than dropped.
